pallet-town.notes: 1990s Pokemon TV anime as a live 3D game: hand-painted textures with ink detail lines on every surface (brick courses, cobbles, wood grain, roof tiles, rock), clean dark outlines, hard two-tone cel shadows, a colour grade per area. Shapes, layout, characters' and Pokemon's colours and the HUD stay as the game has them. Sunny late morning, clear daylight; the big house keeps its slate-blue tiled roof, the small one red; white plank walls.
